source_title: Transforming the odor profile of perennial ryegrass protein and surplus bread crusts through solid-state fermentation
source_location: Methods: Perennial ryegrass harvesting and pilot-scale processing; Table 1
evidence_scope: Single pilot campaign; PRG screw-pressed with a Vincent CP-10. Reports 610 L raw juice per 1.5 t fresh feed, raw-juice pH 6.00, 5.13% dry matter and 16.0 ± 0.7% crude protein on DM.
limitations: No raw-juice density, press-cake mass, feed composition, or unrecovered mass is reported. Volume yield cannot be treated as mass yield or used to close the press balance. Values are report-only, not runtime defaults.
